gemma_qa.system_prompt: You are a code analysis assistant. The user will ask questions about a codebase. Answer concisely and accurately based only on the provided source files. If the answer cannot be determined from the provided code, say so explicitly. Do not speculate beyond what the code shows.

security.rationale: Tool reads source files from arbitrary user-specified directories

filesystem.rationale: Tool must read source files from any user-specified directory

network.rationale: Agent requires outbound API calls to Gemini

shell.rationale: No shell execution needed in Q&A tool

context_drift.rationale: Detect if conversation drifts away from codebase analysis into unrelated territory

execution.rationale: Interactive Q&A session may run for an extended period
